meta.description: Single source of truth for all portfolio projects
meta.usage: Run 'node scripts/sync-projects.js' to update portfolio pages

projects.name: REPPIT
projects.description: Track workouts with real-time timer, progressive overload tracking, and exercise history analytics.
projects.longDescription: A mobile strength training app that tracks your workouts, rest periods, and progress. Features timer modes, workout history, and detailed analytics for serious lifters.

projects.name: NoteApp
projects.description: Offline-first with cloud sync, voice-to-text input, and 200+ automated test cases.
projects.longDescription: A notes app with real-time sync across devices. Features markdown support, folder organization, and AI-powered search to find any note instantly. Built for speed and simplicity.

projects.name: PRIMMO
projects.description: Communicates via WhatsApp and Voice calls. Uses workout data from REPPIT for personalized training guidance.
projects.longDescription: An agentic AI strength coach that communicates via WhatsApp and voice calls. Leverages workout data from REPPIT to provide personalized training guidance, form corrections, and motivation.

projects.name: Spotify Songs
projects.description: AI-assisted original music production for Spotify release. Themes: A Letter to Myself, Island of Sun & Rain, Morning Rush.
projects.longDescription: Original music production using AI-assisted composition and production tools. Creating authentic songs with themes of self-reflection, tropical vibes, and daily life energy.

projects.name: Space Race ML
projects.description: Machine learning project predicting successful rocket landings. IBM Data Science certified.
projects.longDescription: Applied machine learning to predict successful SpaceX rocket landings. Part of IBM Data Science Professional Certificate capstone project.

projects.name: Digital Resume
projects.description: Interactive digital resume with AI assistant, skills radar, and 9-step workflow showcase.
projects.longDescription: A modern portfolio featuring an AI chat assistant, interactive skills radar, project flip cards, and a showcase of the 9-step development workflow.

projects.name: Portfolio Optimizer
projects.description: Integrable dashboard with fundamentals view for easy decision making and portfolio performance tracking.
projects.longDescription: An investment portfolio dashboard that aggregates fundamental data, tracks performance, and provides AI-powered insights for better investment decisions.

projects.name: Quantifyd
projects.tagline: Systematic quant trading platform for Indian markets
projects.description: Covered calls strategy backtesting to smooth portfolio returns. Extensive backtesting & automation.
projects.longDescription: A backtesting platform for covered call options strategies. Analyzes historical data to optimize premium collection while managing downside risk.
